boundary.description: From the junction of Parkfield Drive and Manchester Old Road, E along Manchester Old Road, Middleton Way, Barton Road, Park Road to and E along River Irk, to the point opposite Whitby Street. Then by a beeline NE along, but excluding Gleenwood Drive to the point where Rochdale Canal meets Rochdale – Oldham District boundary. Then S by that boundary to Middleton Road, to and S along Rochdale Canal to junction 21 on M60 Motorway. Then W along the M60 Motorway to Rochdale – Oldham boundary and along that boundary N to the crossing of Green gate and Wince Brook. W along Wince Brook, Round Thorn Road, Mount Road, Manchester New Road, Alkrington Hall Road North, Hall Drive , by a beeline to Wince Brook opposite Greenson Drive and W by the brook to the point where it meets Rochdale – Manchester District boundary.
